# Hand-written expectations (not generated): for each preset role, the operator routes it may
# call. Every route not listed under a role must answer 403. "ALL" means every route.
# Keep this in step with docs/reference/staff-roles/matrix.md, not with the Go table.
# The customer catalog routes (/v1/operator/catalog/*, /v1/operator/customers/*) are listed under no
# role on purpose: deny by default, Owner (ALL) or a direct grant only (see staff_grants_test.go).

[staff.owner]
ALL
